items.title: Fluid Art Deco Wave Lattice Screen for High-Privacy CNC Routing
items.description: Bring timeless elegance to your custom fabrication projects with this continuous Art Deco lattice pattern, showcasing fluid, repeating wave and feather motifs. Provided in high-quality DXF, SVG, and DWG file formats, this dense design provides exceptional coverage making it ideal for architectural privacy screens, exterior balcony railings, and commercial space partitions that require steady airflow and lighting.
